text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Option A 20.0 to 20.8 s. Closer shot of the stopped white car in brown floodwater, with empty seats through the glass and a softened duplex behind. Its amber corner lamps glow at 20.2 to 20.4 s, go dark at 20.6 s and glow again at 20.8 s, which reads as a blink. The car stays put.
